play.history:
Former gang member forced into a life of violence. Escaped, changed her life, and became an ER nurse. Now she secretly hunts the creatures preying on New York while trying to keep her past away.

Iron Will: years of surviving a violent gang and later working in the ER have made her exceptionally resilient; she remains calm under fear, pain and stress.

Danger Sense: her gang past makes her instinctively notice when something is wrong.

Contacts: doctors, nurses, paramedics and medical examiners can provide information to her; underground gang members from her past and some allies cooperate.

Allies: Dr. Jacob Miller, Chief of Emergency Medicine and her mentor, can quietly access records, change schedules, cover up, and shows up whenever she needs him.

Luck: she always seems to survive impossible situations.
